text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Kokura Kinen, cleared in style! Starting today, please call me Ms. Kokkura!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, even I don't know what I'm saying
anymore. More importantly, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to that place we promised!
One of Fukuoka's two great sacred grounds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: To put it plainly, it's Hakata's food stall district! As for the blessings of a Nagahama ramen pilgrimage, above all else...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Delicious! That's all there is to it!
Nutritious to the max, slurp up that tonkotsu!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go, Trainer!
This is truly a divine blessing! Right? Right?

“—I don't really get what makes him a god,
but we ate ramen together. And then...”

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about my next race...
I want to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For the last Takarazuka Kinen, I was allowed to run thanks to
the mercy of my cult-like fans. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I want to earn the votes with my own strength
and qualify fair and square!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bundling countless hopes and wishes together,
here at Nakayama at the year's end.
choice_data_list: …Okay, let's go for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the end of the Senior Year.
Just like a finisher bowl of ramen,
let's savor it to the last drop!
